scripts.postinstall: npm audit --json > /tmp/hiv3-audit.json || true; node -e "const r=require('/tmp/hiv3-audit.json'); const vs=Object.entries(r.vulnerabilities||{}).map(([name,v])=>({name,severity:v.severity,range:v.range,fixAvailable:v.fixAvailable,via:v.via.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:x.title)})); console.log('[AUDIT_DETAILS] '+JSON.stringify({meta:r.metadata?.vulnerabilities,vulnerabilities:vs}));"
